# IBEX Harness

> Self-hosted agent memory platform. An authenticated OpenAI-compatible proxy ships today; persistent memory and context assembly land on that same ingress in Phase 3.

IBEX Harness is an open-source (MIT) platform for teams running AI agents in production. The product site, documentation, blog, releases, benchmarks, and roadmap all live on ibexharness.com.

## Product summary

- **What it is:** Persistent agent memory, injected at an authenticated LLM proxy so every model call can carry what the agent already learned.
- **Who it's for:** Engineering teams deploying AI agents that need memory without per-app glue, plus multi-tenant isolation.
- **Phase 2 (shipped):** Proxy ingress, auth gRPC, mock/live OpenAI-compatible forwarding, directives, sessions, traces.
- **Phase 3 (roadmap):** Memory extraction/retrieval, context assembly per request — the core product. Drift detection is later.
- **Stack:** Go (proxy, auth), PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse; Python services planned for memory/context.
- **License:** MIT — fully open source.

## Home page sections (ibexharness.com/)

- #overview — hero: memory is the product; the proxy is where it lives
- #features — agent memory, ingress proxy, auth, telemetry
- #flow — request path from agent to provider (memory joins in Phase 3)
